heading: Monday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance of showers and thunderstorms, except likely north of Route 2. Lows in the upper 50s to lower 60s. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming west and diminishing, except continuing at 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday
text: Decreasing clouds. Slight chance of a shower, mainly over high terrain, and in the valleys near the Vermont/Québec border. Less humid, with highs in the upper 70s to lower 80s, with some mid 80s in southeastern valleys, and some lower 70s northeast and in the Adirondacks. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Mainly clear, with areas of river valley fog late. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60, some lower 50s in northern cold hollows. Northwest winds becoming light and variable.
